target.title: fix(diagnostics-otel): surface error message on run/harness error spans
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Resolves an issue where a failed agent run shows up in tracing UIs (e.g. Arize Phoenix) as `outcome=error` with **no error message**. The errored `openclaw.run` and `openclaw.harness.run` spans carried only a low-cardinality `errorCategory` (often just `Error`) — and for the harness-completed path, a hardcoded `"error"` string. Operators debugging a failed run see the failure flag but nothing about *what* failed, and no OpenTelemetry exception event is emitted either.

## Why This Change Was Made

The failing error is already in hand at every emit site (`catch (error)` and `result.promptError`) but was reduced to a category before it reached the span. This threads the actual error message through the three error-bearing diagnostic events (`run.completed`, `harness.run.completed`, `harness.run.error`) onto an `openclaw.error` span attribute and the span status message, mirroring the existing `recordWebhookError` handler. Redaction stays in the exporter (`redactSensitiveText`); the raw message is kept **off metric attributes** to preserve histogram cardinality; and the new `error` field is named so the support-bundle redactor scrubs it by field name. `errorCategory` is unchanged for metrics.

Not in scope: the LLM `chat` / `model.call` span abort status, which comes from separate instrumentation.

## User Impact

Operators and developers inspecting traces now see the real failure message on errored `openclaw.run` / `openclaw.harness.run` spans — as the span status and an `openclaw.error` attribute — instead of a bare `error` / `Error` category. Redaction behavior and metric cardinality are unchanged.

## Evidence

Rebased on current `main` (`0e8870da76`):

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/diagnostics-otel/src/service.test.ts` → **103 passed**, including 3 new tests (one per error path). One asserts the raw message stays off the `*.duration_ms` metric attrs.
- `pnpm tsgo:core` → clean (covers `src/agents/harness/lifecycle.ts`, `src/infra/*`).
- `pnpm tsgo:extensions` → clean (covers `extensions/diagnostics-otel/src/service.ts`).

Remaining pre-land gates (this is intentionally a draft): mandatory `$autoreview` and full CI / Testbox validation.
